crossRefs.note: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

translations.web: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.
translations.bsb: The earth takes shape like clay under a seal; its hills stand out like the folds of a garment.
translations.kjv: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.
translations.asv: It is changed as clay under the seal; And all things stand forth as a garment:
